forms.این راهنما به‌صورت پرسش و پاسخ تنظیم شده: This guide is presented in a question-and-answer format. Your surgeon's and care team's individual instructions always take priority over general information.
forms.در چند روز نخست، کمپرس سرد را فقط طبق آم: During the first few days, use a cold compress only as instructed by the care team; reduce salt, drink enough water, avoid excessive bending and strenuous activity, and take prescribed medicines exactly as directed. Swelling is a normal part of healing.
forms.برای بخیه‌های پره و زیر بینی چه مراقبتی: How should I care for the stitches around the nostrils and under the nose?
forms.بخیه‌ها را تمیز نگه دارید، دستکاری نکنید: Keep the stitches clean, do not manipulate them, avoid pressure and impact, and do not stretch the upper lip excessively. Use scar-repair cream only after the stitches are removed and with the care team's approval.
forms.معمولاً پس از ۷۲ ساعت و با رعایت دستور ت: A short shower is usually possible after 72 hours if you follow the care team's instructions. The cast and tape must not get wet or move, the water should not be very hot, and hair should be washed with another person's help using the method you were shown.
forms.در روزهای اول چه بخورم؟: What should I eat during the first few days?
forms.غذاهای سبک، نرم و کم‌نمک انتخاب کنید و ا: Choose light, soft, low-salt foods and avoid hard, spicy, salty foods or anything that requires a lot of chewing. Details of the anti-inflammatory diet are provided in the dedicated nutrition article.
forms.داروها را از چه زمانی شروع کنم؟: When should I start my medicines?
forms.داروها پس از ترخیص و دقیقاً مطابق نسخه آ: Start medicines after discharge exactly as prescribed. Do not independently reduce, increase, or stop antibiotics, painkillers, sprays, saline rinses, or ointments.
forms.معمولاً حدود یک هفته، اما زمان دقیق به ش: Usually for about one week, although the exact timing depends on the condition of the nose and the surgeon's decision. The splint must not become wet, loose, or displaced.
forms.اگر تیم درمان با توجه به وضعیت اختصاصی ش: If the care team has given you different instructions based on your individual condition, follow those instructions.
forms.خونابه یا گرفتگی بینی طبیعی است؟: Is slight bloody discharge or nasal congestion normal?
forms.مقدار کمی خونابه در ۲۴ تا ۷۲ ساعت اول و: A small amount of bloody discharge during the first 24 to 72 hours and mild congestion can be normal. Heavy or persistent bleeding, fever, uncontrolled pain, or significant difficulty breathing must be reported immediately to the follow-up nurse or care team.
forms.آیا یک دستور ثابت برای وضعیت خواب وجود د: Is there one fixed sleeping position after surgery?
forms.خیر. وضعیت خواب و استراحت باید فقط طبق د: No. Your sleeping and resting position must be set only according to your surgeon's individual instructions for your case; do not rely on general advice or outdated internet content.

forms.آمادگی صحیح، اضطراب روز عمل را کاهش می‌د: Proper preparation reduces anxiety on the day of surgery and supports safer surgical planning.
forms.چه افرادی پذیرش نمی‌شوند؟: Who is not accepted for surgery?
People with diabetes or high blood pressure.

forms.آزمایش‌ها، تصویربرداری‌ها و مشاوره‌های د: Complete requested tests, imaging, and consultations within the stated timeframe and bring the results with you.
forms.هیچ دارو یا مکملی را خودسرانه قطع یا شرو: Do not stop or start any medicine or supplement on your own; changes must be made only on the advice of your treating doctor and surgical team.

forms.بدون آرایش، لاک، زیورآلات، لنز و وسایل غ: Arrive without makeup, nail polish, jewelry, contact lenses, or unnecessary belongings, and wear comfortable button-up or zip-front clothing.

forms.این مقاله از فایل اختصاصی و تأییدشده کلی: This article is based on the clinic's dedicated, approved material and is not intended to be copied from or replaced with content from other websites. Its purpose is to support tissue healing and inflammation control alongside medical instructions.
forms.افراد دارای بیماری مزمن یا زمینه‌ای باید: People with chronic or underlying conditions should review their diet and supplements with their treating doctor. Diabetes or high blood pressure are among the conditions that make a patient ineligible for surgery at this clinic.

forms.شیر، ماست، بستنی و هر نوع لبنیات ممنوع ا: Milk, yogurt, ice cream, and all dairy products are prohibited; cottage cheese is the only exception and is allowed in the prescribed amount because of its high protein content. forms.اولویت با سبزیجات کم‌کربوهیدرات مانند بر: Give priority to lower-carbohydrate vegetables such as broccoli, lettuce, cabbages, cucumber, celery, cauliflower, sprouts, watercress, and spinach. If you have digestive sensitivity, lightly steam the vegetables.
forms.به‌دلیل التهاب‌زا بودن در این رژیم ممنوع: They are prohibited in this diet because they are considered inflammation-promoting; mashed potatoes are also not allowed.
forms.میوه را متعادل مصرف کنید. هندوانه، طالبی: Eat fruit in moderation. Watermelon, melon, and strawberries are among the lower-carbohydrate choices; apricots, mulberries, cranberries, peaches, kiwi, apples, blueberries, grapes, pomegranate, and pears can also be included in a balanced plan. Excess fruit and fruit juice are not recommended because of their sugar content; whole fruit is preferred to juice.
Cooked legumes such as beans, lentils, and split peas.
forms.کینوا، جو دوسر، چاودار و نان کامل جو طبق: Quinoa, oats, rye, and whole-grain barley bread according to individual tolerance.
forms.روغن‌های کنجد، کانولا، آفتابگردان، کتان: Sesame, canola, sunflower, flaxseed, and olive oils; hydrogenated and partially hydrogenated oils are not recommended.
forms.برنج، شیربرنج و همه فرآورده‌های برنجی مم: Rice, rice pudding, and all rice products are prohibited.
forms.فرآورده‌های حاوی آرد گندم، ذرت، نشاسته ذ: Products containing wheat flour, corn, cornstarch, and breakfast cereals are also not recommended.
forms.ماهی‌های آب آزاد مانند سالمون، قزل‌آلا،: Wild-caught fish such as salmon, trout, sardines, and tuna for their beneficial fats.
forms.گوشت سفید ماکیان مانند مرغ و بوقلمون در: White poultry meat such as chicken and turkey in moderation.
forms.تخم‌مرغ یا تخم بلدرچینِ مطمئن به‌عنوان م: Eggs or safely sourced quail eggs as a protein source.
forms.غذاهای دریایی پوسته‌سخت، ماهی پرورشی، گو: Shellfish, farmed fish, red meat, and organ meats are not recommended in the clinic's suggested plan.
forms.روزانه حدود ۲ تا ۲٫۵ لیتر آب، مگر این‌که: About 2 to 2.5 litres of water per day unless your doctor has prescribed a different restriction.
Herbal tea and infusions in moderation.
forms.آب‌های گازدار، نوشیدنی انرژی‌زا و ترکیبا: Carbonated water, energy drinks, and high-caffeine products are not recommended.
forms.در روزهای نخست پس از جراحی، نوشیدنی بسیا: During the first days after surgery, avoid extremely hot or ice-cold drinks; choose a moderate temperature.
forms.در این رژیم، شیر، ماست، بستنی و هر نوع ف: In this diet, milk, yogurt, ice cream, and every type of dairy product are prohibited. Cottage cheese is the only approved exception and may be consumed in the prescribed amount because of its high protein content.
forms.گردو، فندق و پسته در حد متعادل قابل استف: Walnuts, hazelnuts, and pistachios may be used in moderation; peanuts and peanut products are not recommended in the approved plan. Limit spicy seasonings and salt. Turmeric and ginger should be used only within the plan and with consideration of your medicines. Every supplement, including vitamins C or E, must be approved by your doctor.
forms.سیگار، قلیان، ویپ و سایر مواد دخانی خون‌: Cigarettes, hookah, vaping, and other tobacco products impair tissue blood flow and oxygen delivery and may increase the risk of infection and poor healing. According to the clinic file, stopping tobacco at least 3 to 4 weeks before and 4 to 6 weeks after surgery is recommended. Alcohol can also increase blood pressure, inflammation, and swelling.

forms.خیر؛ برنج، شیربرنج و فرآورده‌های برنجی د: No. Rice, rice pudding, and rice products are prohibited in this diet.
forms.این رژیم تا چه مدت ادامه دارد؟: How long should I follow this diet?
forms.رژیم ضدالتهابی حداقل تا یک ماه پس از جرا: Continue the anti-inflammatory diet for at least one month after surgery unless the care team gives you a different plan. Food quality, balanced meals, and adherence to individualized instructions are more important than any generic list.
